name: @bunest/i18n
description: Internationalization for Bunest: per-request AsyncLocalStorage locale resolution, typed translations, Intl formatting, and localized validation messages

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --format esm --external @bunest/common --external @bunest/core --external @bunest/http --external @bunest/validation --external reflect-metadata --external class-validator --external class-transformer
